name: Onager
author: Abstract Games factory (game by Néstor Romeral Andrés, 2012)
description: Onager (Néstor Romeral Andrés, 2012): a hexagon-of-hexes race inspired by Epaminondas. Each player fills the two rows nearest himself with 13 discs, then three neutral 'lakes' are dropped on the board to break the symmetry. On your turn you either walk a piece to an adjacent empty space or fire it like a catapult: two friendly pieces aligned with nothing between them, one jumping over the other and landing exactly as far beyond as they were apart — clear across the board if the line is open. Nothing is ever captured; a piece landing on an enemy simply stacks on top of it, burying it until the top disc moves away. You win at the start of your turn if you have more pieces on the opponent's back rank than he has on yours.
